title: PIXL 8000 Tropical Wave Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Tropical Wave is a complex blend of Coconut, Pineapple, Lime and Guava, offering a layered tropical flavour with creamy, tangy and citrus elements. It’s a bright, exotic vape that keeps your tastebuds guessing. Each pod is filled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and paired with a 10ml refill reservoir. When used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this setup delivers up to 8000 puffs with smooth mesh coil flavour throughout. Draw-activated and designed for MTL vaping with Boost Mode available, Tropical Wave stands out for its complexity and balance. A great option for vapers who enjoy adventurous fruit combinations.
